function surface(parent,name,nu,nv,sample,mat,reverse=false) {

function mapTexture(kind) {

function addFuzz(owner,objects,count) {
  const pos=[],colors=[];
  const chosen=objects.filter(m=>m.isMesh);
  for(let i=0;i<count;i++) {
    const obj=chosen[Math.floor(random()*chosen.length)];
    const geo=obj.geometry,a=geo.attributes.position,n=geo.attributes.normal,c=geo.attributes.color;
    const idx=Math.floor(random()*a.count);

    const tangent=V(random()-.5,random()-.65,random()-.5);
    tangent.addScaledVector(d,-tangent.dot(d)).normalize();
    const w=V(0,0,0).crossVectors(d,tangent).multiplyScalar(.105+.075*random());
    const tip=p.clone().addScaledVector(d,.32+random()*.48).addScaledVector(tangent,.32);

    pos.push(p.x+w.x,p.y+w.y,p.z+w.z,p.x-w.x,p.y-w.y,p.z-w.z,tip.x,tip.y,tip.z);
    const color=c?new THREE.Color().fromBufferAttribute(c,idx):goldColor.clone();
    color.multiplyScalar(.83+random()*.30);
    for(let j=0;j<3;j++)colors.push(color.r,color.g,color.b);
  }
  const geom=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geom.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
  geom.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors,3));
  geom.computeVertexNormals();
  const fuzz=new THREE.Mesh(geom,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({vertexColors:true,side:THREE.DoubleSide,roughness:1}));
  fuzz.name='short surface fibres';owner.add(fuzz);
}
